segments.name: K2
segments.prompt: A chibi nine-tailed fox empress in white and gold armour with very long red hair and nine big fluffy fox tails fanned behind her, wielding a long-hafted crescent moon glaive, already recoiling from a hard hit at the first frame, dazed with eyes shut, immediately begins recovering: no second jolt. She opens her eyes, steadies herself with a slight knee flex and returns smoothly to her guard stance of the last frame; hair, cape and tails swing with one diminishing overshoot. Feet adjust minimally between the supplied endpoint stances, staying grounded without sliding or hopping; no turning or scale change. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the weapon action; hair, cloth and tails follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid weapon, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added flames, aura or particles.
